title: Day 1 on the dry farm, guided start running
about: A brand-new game (as day1-fresh): the farm is straw-coloured from fence to fence (valley.json maps.farm, the dry palette), Rosa's three ripe parsnips the only green. The guided start runs unchanged. Compare its draws with day1-fresh; check crops, the target marker, tilled and watered soil and the path keep contrast.
